task: Deepen flagship 7 (photo-editing): develop DNG raw files into 16-bit masters, checked against LibRaw on real camera files

errors.what: First LibRaw comparison on the Canon had 10% of pixels over one 8-bit step (deep shadows) and Nikon highlight-edge outliers up to 75 steps
errors.fix: clamp each sensel at 0 and at its white-balanced clip level before demosaicing, as LibRaw does; now 0 pixels over one step on both files

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing next said raw.pixls.us/rawsamples.ch 403 so real RAW was unavailable; rawpy's GitHub test folder (git clone --filter=blob:none, then checkout single files) has real CR2/NEF and pypi rawpy gives LibRaw as a reference. Noted in the entry.

deviations.why: Took flagship 7 instead of flagship 1: wall-framing-takeoff had 265 commits in 7 days and every open item on it needs outside real inputs; photo-editing's RAW development was agent-doable with a real-data check available.
deviations.did: built raw_develop.py and a LibRaw differential
deviations.result: landed with real-file agreement within one 8-bit step

goal: Flagship deepening: RAW development was the open item on photo-editing's next.
notes: Verification: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests in ventures/photo-editing: 537 tests, 2 not passing, both environmental and unrelated to this change (test_workspace_health permission test fails as root, documented in AGENTS.md; test_real_photo_calibration imports the system Pillow, which is broken in this container: ImportError _imaging). tests/test_raw_develop.py 18/18 OK. ruff check (0.15.8) and mypy (1.19.1) clean. LibRaw differential (rawpy 0.28.0 / LibRaw 0.22.2): Nikon NEF full 4284x2844 max 0.51 step, half max 0.46; Canon 5D II CR2 full 5634x3752 max 0.60, half max 0.53; 0 pixels over one step in all four.
